fieldValues.title: Charter: WG Third-party ready
fieldValues.decision_question: Does the owner delegate the WG Third-party ready mandate on the terms in the group role and its four standing orders?
fieldValues.decision_statement: Ratified: the group role 834b61fd and its standing orders (membership and quorum, cycle and report, budget, reporting and minutes) are the mandate of the Third-party ready working group, under the SRS implementation compass. Amendments need a new owner decision.
fieldValues.rationale: semanticops.com#31; compass boundaries B0-B3 from srs-programme PR #51.
